checks.name: acceptance
checks.scope: Actual public renderer return versus exception; a non-SVG return is still acceptance and fails format separately.

checks.name: svg-format
checks.scope: Strict XML and SVG root namespace.

checks.name: positive-canvas
checks.scope: Positive finite viewBox or explicit width/height.

checks.name: label:Header
checks.scope: Authored rendered text, excluding hidden/metadata/defs text; computed CSS and clipping remain unmeasured.

checks.name: label:Payload
checks.scope: Authored rendered text, excluding hidden/metadata/defs text; computed CSS and clipping remain unmeasured.

checks.name: svg-unique-ids
checks.scope: Document IDs must be unique; repeated data-id values are renderer-specific.

checks.name: model:["rows",0,0,"bits"]
checks.scope: Authored expected value against separately invoked public parse model; not a claim about painted output.

checks.name: model:["rows",0,1,"start"]
checks.scope: Authored expected value against separately invoked public parse model; not a claim about painted output.

checks.name: model:["rows",0,1,"end"]
checks.scope: Authored expected value against separately invoked public parse model; not a claim about painted output.

checks.name: painted-semantic-correspondence
checks.expected: native semantic facts correspond to owned visible geometry
checks.scope: No reviewed renderer/family paint projection is available; label retention alone does not establish it.

unmeasuredScopes: Perceptual legibility, font metrics, text clipping and complete shape/path paint correspondence are not measured.
qualification.scope: Public model facts and SVG admission, with painted semantic correspondence explicitly unmeasured where no reviewed projection exists.
